issue: Signature line: नारायण शरणागत अति अघ अघहारी … चाहत चितहारी. With the third-person चाहत, नारायण reads as the poet naming himself; the glossary's नारायण is the Lord only.
our reading: Nārāyaṇa (the poet), a great sinner, has come to your refuge, remover of sin; he longs for the purifying dust of your feet, stealer of hearts.
alternatives: नारायण as an address to the Lord: O Nārāyaṇa, (I) have come to your refuge, very sinful …
